title: Phom Naga
text: The Phom Naga people number 52,682 according to the 2011 Census of India, comprising a significant portion of the scheduled tribes in Nagaland.[5] Note: The 2021 Census of India was postponed and not conducted as of 2025; figures are from 2011.

text: Phom Naga is a stable indigenous language of India. It belongs to the Sino-Tibetan language family. Direct evidence is lacking, but the language is thought to be used as a first language by all in the ethnic community.
